name: mtdp
description: Missing Trailer Downloader for Plex (MTDP) Main Features 🔍 Detects Missing Trailers: Scans your Plex libraries for items that lack trailers. (either Plex Pass or local) ▼ Filters out specified Genres: You may not want trailers for concerts or 3 minute shorts.. 🎥 Automatic Downloading: Uses YT-DLP to fetch the best available trailer from Youtube. 📂 Organized Storage: Trailers are saved according to Plex guidelines for both Movies and TV Shows. 🔄 Refreshes Metadata: Refreshes metadata of items with new trailer. (Necessary for Plex to 'detect' them) 🖥️ webUI: Change settings, keep track and trigger manual downloads

paths.name: Media Path
paths.description: Mount your media directory (same as Plex sees it) Eg /mnt/user/data/media/

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Match your location (e.g.: America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo)

variables.name: SCHEDULE_HOURS
variables.description: Run every X hours (default: 24) - CRON=0 2 * * * # Optional: cron schedule (overrides SCHEDULE_HOURS - Configure cron via webUI)
